# Test fixtures

Real War Thunder sight files used as parser/validator test data:

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `community_template.blk` | `explain.blk` from [3794432/war_thunder_custom_sights](https://github.com/3794432/war_thunder_custom_sights) (MIT) — a complete UserSights template with every drawing block |
| `wiki_p40_it_san_giorgio_x4.blk` | P40 example from the official wiki article [User-made sighting reticles](https://wiki.warthunder.com/User-made_sighting_reticles) (kept verbatim, including its `3,5` typo) |
| `wiki_t55_ballistics.blk` | T-55A `ballistics` block from the same article |
| `wiki_default_scales.blk` | default `crosshair_distances` / `crosshair_hor_ranges` from the same article |
| `wiki_draw_blocks.blk` | `drawLines` / `drawTexts` / `drawCircles` / `drawQuads` snippets from the same article (verbatim, the `drawTexts` block is not closed there) |
| `wiki_draw_blocks_fixed.blk` | the same with the missing `}` added |

`*.png` / `*.jpg` are generated by `scripts/make-fixtures.mjs`.
